notes.title: Update August 31, 2022
notes.notes:
Hey Labyrinth Players!

This latest update covers a few new items and addresses some bugs as well. Here is the change log:

•	New Reassessment rules and interface.
•	Several updates to the Token Help popup.
•	Added an "end-of-turn" phase for the Jihadist player so that cadres can be removed before passing  play to their opponent.
•	Disrupt overlay now shows the status of selected cells/cadres after resolving.
•	Fixed an issue where information on the Disrupt overlay would disappear when selecting a second target.
•	Fixed some display issues regarding the Tony Blair overlay.
•	Fixed an issue with Radicalization not sending the correct plot event. 
•	Fixed an issue where "Adam Gadahn" was not displaying the Recruit overlay.
•	Fixed an issue where the Posture tokens on the GWOT/Prestige popup could be dragged.
•	Fixed various missing button sounds.
•	Fixed OPs Tray issues for various resolutions.
•	Fixed some Rulebook art and text issues.

Please let us know if you have any issues with the build in the forum and follow these directions for submitting Save Files so we can track them down: https://steamcommunity.com/app/931950/discussions/0/3203745634163788523/

You can send feedback as well as issues to support@playdekgames.com. Thanks for playing!

Playdek

notes.title: Big Changes & Something Really Exciting...
notes.notes:
Dear Labyrinth players: today we have a big update that comes with a lot of changes and surprises. 

We are excited to finally bring you the all new US AI mode! This AI has been a work in progress and a long time coming, but we feel like now it is ready to share with you. As we will continue to improve it as time goes on, we would like players to share their save games with cases where the AI makes a poor choice (even if the save game is past that decision point), or if any other problems arise. [u][b]Note:[/b][/u] This AI is currently only implemented for the US, not the Jihadist. 

[u]Patch Notes:[/u]

- Added US A.I. for offline game play

- Besieged Regime token fixed

- US War of Ideas Operation overlay clean up

- Fixed an issue with the UN Nation Building GWOT Penalty and the Total Modifier

- War of Ideas Operations Overlay feedback added

- Clean up to the display of Regime Change and US Prestige Roll

- Fixed game re-load issue not displaying +1 Prestige

- Game log clean up for Travel Attempt and US Prestige Roll

- Jihadist Funding marker display improved for Major Jihad Success result

- Interface display improvements for discard pile reshuffle

- Improved the interface and feedback for selecting posture for a country

- Cleaned up Pause/Unpause

- Art updates and improvements

- Cleaned up Pause/Un-pause

- Updated art and graphics improvements


Thank you guys for your patience and continuous support; we hope you enjoy the new AI and remember, don't forget to let us know if there are any problems or find anything that hinders your playing experience.

notes.title: Update 05 - v 0.7.4, patch notes, and Mac support!
notes.notes:
Hey there guys! Thank you all so much for the support and engagement with the Labyrinth community, your feedback has been very valuable to us; please continue to offer it as we continue to improve the Labyrinth experience. 

We are very excited to announce that we finally support Mac OS Catalina! Thanks to everyone very much for your patience and dedication, we hope the wait was well worth it. If you encounter any issues with the Mac build, please feel free to bring it up in the Steam Community. 

This update also has a few additional fixes and improvements.  

Here are the patch notes for this build:

•	Added updated tool tips in the front end.
•	Added updated tutorial art
•	Fixed an issue preventing the forfeit and network disconnect windows from appearing
•	Various art updates/fixes/clean up throughout.
•	Fixed cards not appearing in discard/removed tray
•	Fixed an issue with deploying into a country that already has troops
•	Added highlighting to several tutorial steps
•	Added MacOS notarization (support for Catalina)

We are doing additional work on tutorial features and also the AI, and will updated everyone on with roadmap on that development. Until then, keep enjoying Labyrinth; we really appreciate the support. 

Hope you guys enjoy; stay safe and happy gaming!

notes.title: Labyrinth Progress Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We really appreciate the tremendous support that has been shown for Labyrinth. We are truly thankful to be able to work with such a great community of gamers. Your feedback has been very helpful and we encourage you to continue to provide your issues, thoughts and ideas here in the Steam community hub. 

We are making continued progress on fixing and polishing Labyrinth while also working to bring more features online. The latest update is out and with it comes a significant rework to the structure of the Jihadist tutorial. From here each section will be modified further with additional art cues and improved flow but this gets it headed down that path. The U.S. tutorial will also get the same treatment. This update also has quite a few interface clean up improvements as well numerous rules and bug fixes. 

The patch note details can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/931950/discussions/0/2149847423917974753/]here:[/url]

For the Mac build, we are making progress with Unity and the Mac certification issue. There have been a few more hurdles than we anticipated but estimate that the full Mac release will be ready by the end of next week.

As for the near term roadmap, we are working with the Labyrinth design team on advanced tutorials that go into further depth on key game aspects as well as general game strategies. We will bring these online in steps and get community feedback at each stage. These will be next in the major update queue with A.I. coming after that.

Again please continue to share your thoughts and ideas on the game and we look forward to making this the best possible digital board game experience!
